categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Matches the P2P label and modifies connection management and peer anchor preservation in src/net.cpp and src/net.h.
categories.rationale: Fixing anchor loss when networking is inactive preserves node eclipse resistance across restarts. As described, shutting down offline previously overwrote anchors.dat with an empty list and popped cached anchors from memory, discarding block-relay connections needed to protect nodes on subsequent startup.

categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Does not touch RPC interface files or RPC handling; the change is entirely within net.cpp and net.h connection logic.
categories.rationale: The PR addresses internal networking connection state rather than the RPC interface, even though setnetworkactive is one trigger for the bug.
